What is Tibb-e-Nabwi

Guidance rooted in the Sunnah.

Tibb-e-Nabwi refers to health and healing guidance found in the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (Peace Be Upon Him). This timeless tradition offers remedies, practices, and lifestyle habits that promote health, balance, and harmony.

لِكُلِّ دَاءِ دَوَاءٌ

“There is a medicine for every disease.”

Hadith #2204 · Sahih Muslim
Meet the founder ↗
01
01 / FOUNDER

Founder of
Nature's Choice.

Azmat Aapa is a leading practitioner of Tibb-e Nabwi and the founder of Nature's Choice, offering over 90 natural remedies since 2020. She also established Quran for Kids and the Institute of Tibb-e-Nabwi Medicine.

02 / EDUCATOR

Educator, Author,
& Innovator.

She has taught Tibb-e Nabwi, authored two books, and developed remedies blending Sunnah wisdom with modern health needs.

03 / IMPACT

International &
Nationwide Impact.

Traveling across Pakistan and Canada, Azmat Aapa delivers lectures, conducts clinics, and promotes preventive care and holistic wellness.

04 / MISSION

Reviving prophetic medicine for modern life.

Her work revives Prophetic Medicine as a modern, practical approach to achieving physical, emotional, and spiritual health.
